description: This Java source file defines the GatewayDuplicateHeaderException class, a custom exception used within the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate that a request contained duplicate header fields. The class includes methods for constructing instances from messages or JSON objects, and a nested builder class for fluent creation of exceptions.
